feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: U.S. ambassador to the U.N. discusses progress on key issues
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with U.S. Ambassador to the U.N. Mike Waltz about President Trump's visit to the U.N. General Assembly and whether progress has been made on key issues.

entry.title: Trump touts his economy and U.S. actions in Iran in UNGA address
entry.summary: President Trump touted what he portrayed as international and domestic triumphs in a speech to the U.N. General Assembly.

entry.title: U.N. Ambassador Mike Waltz on Iran, Venezuela and Trump's foreign policy
entry.summary: Deals, threats and oil are all on the table as the president's foreign policy takes center stage.

entry.title: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
entry.summary: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

entry.title: ICE is looking into 'mobile detention facilities'
entry.summary: Buried in the paperwork for Immigration and Customs Enforcement's expansion in Pennsylvania is a document requesting "mobile detention facilities."

entry.title: Trump is on voters' minds in the midterms -- and they're not happy, poll shows
entry.summary: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds President Trump — and his unpopularity — is an outsize factor in why most voters say they want Democrats to win the midterms.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Trump flaunts U.S. power during UNGA speech, poll finds Trump's unpopularity is a major factor swaying voters to Democrats for midterms, media outlets banned by Trump get their day in court.

entry.title: Ukraine's Zelenskyy proposes energy truce with Russia during meeting with Trump
entry.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met President Trump at the U.N. and proposed that Ukraine and Russia stop attacking each other's energy systems.

entry.title: A look at the legacy and influence Nancy Pelosi will leave behind when she retires
entry.summary: Rep. Nancy Pelosi will retire following the 2026 midterm elections, ending her almost 40-year career in Congress, but leaving a lasting influence on U.S. politics.

entry.title: China's Xi Jinping to meet with Trump at White House this week
entry.summary: As China's Xi Jinping meets with President Trump at the White House on Thursday. Talks will touch on Iran and how Beijing is circumventing U.S. sanctions.
